title: rclone from 1.59.0 before 1.76.0 contains a confinement escape in the local backend's setXattr… (CVE-2026-134354)
description: rclone versions from 1.59.0 up to but not including 1.76.0 contain a vulnerability in the local backend's setXattr function. This flaw allows attackers to escape confinement by writing user.* extended attributes outside the intended destination root directory via a specially crafted symlink. Exploitation requires the attacker to plant a symlink pointing to an external directory with existing child files and use specific rclone operations (--links --metadata) to set extended attributes on those external files.
